title: machine projects.toml
description: Project list consumed by `bin/machine`. Each top-level table (other than reserved keys) defines a Lima VM.

default_profile.description: Profile name applied when a project omits `profiles`.

default_shell.description: Login shell applied when a project omits `shell`.

repos.description: Git remotes to clone into ~/code/<basename>/. The first is the primary.

profiles.description: Profile TOMLs to stack on top of provision.toml.

shell.description: Login shell for the VM's user. Defaults to top-level `default_shell` or `zsh`.
